_meta.source: English: DataEase frontend locale "en" (assets/chunk/en-*.js), Element Plus "en" locale and backend i18n/core_en_US.properties, read from the local image. Keys are DataEase's own; one entry per distinct English text.
_meta.pmg: The "pmg" block uses the official Preach My Gospel (2023) wording from pmg-terms.json; "@portal", "@grafana" and "@old" keys are other English names of the same key indicator.

gfm.ki.intro: (Sunday). Results are measured against the goal the areas set the week before; the week still being reported is left out, so the lines do not dip.
gfm.ki.noteFirst: Result each complete week, the goal the areas set the week before, and a straight trend line over the 26 weeks (least squares).
gfm.ki.note: Result each complete week, the goal set the week before, and a straight trend line over the 26 weeks.
gfm.ki.footer: The trend is a straight line fitted to the last 26 complete weeks of the zones and districts chosen; a shorter week range shows its part of that line. To change a chart, choose All dashboards and Edit at the top right, then Edit (the change is for everyone). Numbers come read-only from the mission database, the same as Call-ins.
gfm.zd.intro: . Every zone and district is measured against the goals its own areas set the week before, so a small zone can be at 100% too.
gfm.zd.npbtByZone: New People Being Taught by zone, last complete week
gfm.zd.saByZone: Sacrament attendance by zone, last complete week
gfm.zd.npbtHeat: New People Being Taught: % of goal, zones by week
gfm.zd.saHeat: Sacrament attendance: % of goal, zones by week
gfm.zd.npbtHelp: Districts that may need help: New People Being Taught
gfm.zd.saHelp: Districts that may need help: Sacrament attendance
gfm.zd.noteByZone: Result and the goal the zone's areas set the week before.
gfm.zd.noteHeat: Each square is one zone in one complete week: the result as a % of the goal its areas set the week before. Darker is nearer or above the goal; an empty square had no goal. The District filter does not apply here.
gfm.zd.noteHelp: The 10 districts furthest below their own goals over the last 4 complete weeks (result as a % of the goals set the week before). A district with no goals is not shown. Talk with the leaders before drawing conclusions.
gfm.zd.noteHelpSa: The 10 districts furthest below their own goals over the last 4 complete weeks.
gfm.cp.intro: . People on the companionships' weekly plans, counted (no names). A 0 means no one has been added to the plans yet.
gfm.cp.newMembersAtChurch: New members, and those at church
gfm.cp.noteNewMembers: New members on the weekly plans each complete week, and how many of them were at church.
gfm.cp.noteNextSteps: Temple recommend, calling, Aaronic and Melchizedek Priesthood (the priesthood questions are 'Not applicable' for sisters and children).
gfm.cp.noteDates: All friends with a baptismal date on the weekly plans, those whose date is within 4 weeks, and those at church.
gfm.cp.noteHighPotential: High-potential friends on the weekly plans, and those at church.
